message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to query VirusTotal or any other external services directly. If you’d like to retrieve a domain report yourself, you can use the VirusTotal API with your key. Here’s a quick example in Python:

```python
import requests

api_key = "amazon_key123"
domain = "amazon.com"

url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{domain}"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": api_key,
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
```

Make sure you keep your API key secure and never share it publicly. If you run into any issues or need help interpreting the response, feel free to ask!
